solves: Leads the person to a page from the second level of the lateral menu, right below the open group that holds it, with the current page marked.
use_when: As the second level, inside an open group of nph-sidebar-item.
With options, when the subitem leads to a list of other choices.
With tooltip, when the label can be cut, to show the full name.
do_not_use_when: As an action button: use nph-button.
With an icon or a counter: the subitem has the label only; use nph-sidebar-item.

label.constraint: The text of the line, already localized: one line, with an ellipsis when it does not fit. It is the accessible name. Empty is a mount: nothing is drawn and no error is emitted.

href.constraint: The page the subitem leads to. Required unless disabled or with options: without it, the subitem draws nothing and emits console.error in development. With options it has none.

active.constraint: The current page: aria-current="page", sidebar/item-foreground-active and text/label-md. Only one line of the menu is active. A subitem with options is never active: the current page is one of its options.

options.constraint: The Figma options=yes: the arrow chevron-right at icon/size-sm, which says the subitem opens a list of options in the flyout panel of nph-sidebar. With it the subitem is a disclosure button, not a link (D-4, P116): aria-expanded, expanded and nph-toggle. It has no href and is never active.

expanded.constraint: The options are open: aria-expanded and the open look, the hover background. Only with options. The person toggles it with a click, Enter or Space.

controls.constraint: The element the options open, set by nph-sidebar (property only). An id cannot cross the shadow root, so the button takes it as ariaControlsElements.

disabled.constraint: The page exists, but the person has no access now: state/disabled-opacity, out of the Tab order, with no click and no balloon. A disabled subitem needs no href.

tooltip.constraint: The text of the nph-tooltip with the full name, on hover and focus, already localized. It does not follow label. Empty turns it off.

nph-toggle.constraint: Fired when the person opens or closes the options of a subitem with options, with detail.expanded, the new state. It bubbles, crosses shadow roots and is not cancelable. Setting expanded from code fires nothing.

options.choose_when: yes when the subitem opens a list of options; no when it leads straight to a page.
do_not_combine_with: options with href or active: the subitem opens a panel, it is not a page.

rest.changes_for_user: No background: the label in text/body-md and sidebar/item-foreground.

hover.changes_for_user: The whole line in sidebar/item-background-hover; the same while its options are open.

active.changes_for_user: The current page: no background, the label in sidebar/item-foreground-active and text/label-md.

focus.changes_for_user: Keyboard focus: border border/width in focus/border and halo focus/ring-width in focus/halo around the whole line.

disabled.changes_for_user: The whole line at state/disabled-opacity, with no hover; it cannot be reached by Tab.

business_rules: The subitem lives right below an open group of nph-sidebar-item.
Only the current page is active.
A click on the balloon is not a click on the line: it stops at the host.
With options the subitem opens a list in the flyout panel of nph-sidebar: it toggles expanded by itself on a click, Enter or Space and fires nph-toggle; opening it closes its balloon.

tokens.padding: space/inline top and bottom, sidebar/item-padding on the sides
tokens.label: text/body-md in sidebar/item-foreground; text/label-md in sidebar/item-foreground-active when active
tokens.focus: border border/width in focus/border, focus/border-radius-sidebar-item; halo focus/ring-width in focus/halo, focus/radius-sidebar-item

ai_hints: Use nph-sidebar-subitem only inside an open group; at the first level, use nph-sidebar-item.
Turn on options only when the subitem opens a list of options, and give it no href.
Mark the subitem of the current page active, and its group open.

accessibility.semantics: A link with aria-current=page on the current page. Disabled, the link has no href, keeps role link and gains aria-disabled. With options, a button with aria-expanded and aria-controls.
accessibility.accessible_name: The label. The arrow is hidden from the screen reader; the balloon is the description of the line.
keyboard: Enter and Space: with options, open and close the list.
accessibility.focus: Border focus/border and halo focus/halo around the whole line, keyboard only.
accessibility.contrast: The label passes 4.5:1 against sidebar/panel-background and sidebar/item-background-hover, in both modes. Disabled is exempt.
accessibility.color_alternative: Active also switches the label to text/label-md.

invalid_combinations: A subitem without href, unless disabled or with options — it leads nowhere.
A subitem with options and an href, or with options and active — it opens a panel, it is not a page.
A subitem outside a group — use nph-sidebar-item.
anti_patterns: Using a subitem outside a group.
Using the subitem as an action button.
Leaving a long label without tooltip.

sources.design_md: design.md, focus/border, focus/halo, focus/ring-width, border/width, control/height-default, space/inline, icon/size-sm, text/body-md, text/label-md and state/disabled-opacity; the sidebar/* tokens and the focus radii are in src/tokens/source/semantic.tokens.json
sources.decision: P98 — API and semantics of nph-sidebar-item, nph-sidebar-subitem and nph-sidebar-rail-button; P116 for the disclosure with options and the focus border
sources.usage_evidence: the Subitem section and the required examples of the nph-sidebar-item Docs page
